test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are sitting in a straight row facing the north. Only two people sit to the left of C. Only two people sit between A and B.

B sits to the left of A. E is an immediate neighbour of A to the right. Only one person sits to the right of D. F is not an immediate neighbour of B. Who sits at the centre?
solution:
According to the given statement, we have:

Step 1): Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are sitting in a straight row facing the north. Only two people sit to the left of C. Only one person sits to the right of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51f0951c26aac6581e9d50e09551193877b2a64341ca11da916e3761ebb5cdac.png] 

Step 2): Only two people sit between A and B. B sits to the left of A. E is an immediate neighbour of A to the right. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/daebd251d957fd339ea9ef7c2e5f061a111546c0d3043e59f2d085d338c0f4d3.png] 

Step 3): F is not an immediate neighbour of B. Thus the final arrangement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/535fe7bc8bd4974ffe8f5f9f4176386dbe456e8e694c3fee278ffe1736d92d66.png] 

Thus, **A** sits at the center.

Hence, the correct answer is '__**option 4**__'.
